import.subtitle: Register cross-border applications received via the HealthData@EU National Contact Point (NCP). Each imported application is automatically placed in Submitted status and the statutory decision deadline starts from the submission timestamp.
import.infoItem1: Applications are submitted by a researcher via a sending HDAB in a member state
import.infoItem2: The sending HDAB forwards the application to HDAB-NL via the HealthData@EU NCP
import.infoItem3: HDAB-NL assesses the application against Dutch legal and technical requirements
import.infoItem4: The outcome (permit / refusal) is communicated back via the NCP

permitChanges.title: Change requests (D6.4 §9.3/§9.4)
permitChanges.empty: No amendment, renewal or appeal requests yet.
permitChanges.effectiveDateHint: Leave blank to apply immediately. A future date defers activation until staff completes it (D6.4 R9.3.9).
permitChanges.justificationPlaceholder: Justification provided by the data user

changeTypeHint.AMENDMENT: Changes the conditions of the current permit (e.g. scope, data, SPE setup, authorised persons). Creates a new permit version — can take effect immediately or on a future date, to allow time to reconfigure the SPE (D6.4 R9.3.9).
changeTypeHint.RENEWAL: Extends the permit's validity date only — nothing else about the permit changes. Takes effect immediately, and is limited to one renewal per permit (D6.4 R9.4.5, R9.4.8).
changeTypeHint.REVOCATION_APPEAL: Only available after a permit has been revoked. If approved, reinstates the permit as a new version, with immediate effect (D6.4 R9.3.10, R9.4.9–9.4.13).

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.description: Every successful action that isn't a status transition — reference-data changes and case-workflow actions like authorized persons, appeals, and invoices. Status transitions themselves are recorded on the record they acted on (application/permit/SPE-provisioning history).

securityLog.title: Security log
securityLog.description: Rejected and unauthorized access attempts (OWASP A09) — successful actions are logged elsewhere, on the record they acted on.

resumePreScreening.description: The applicant has submitted additional information; pre-screening resumes. Deadline recalculated (D6.4 §8).

autoNegativeNoResponse.description: The applicant did not submit additional information within the deadline (D6.4 Fig. 1/2).

negativeDecision.label: Issue negative decision
